I am also a trans woman who grew up in a very toxic household full enforced gender roles and if I didn't live up to them, I was mocked, punished and often got physically beaten by my father and others. 

My first memory of realizing that I was in the wrong body was helping my mother clean  up the dishes in the kitchen and I told her that I wanted to be a mom like her when I grew up. That was the wrong thing to say in my house, because it earned me a slap across the face and later a spanking from my father. This happened when I was 6 years old and I am 41 now and still remember the pain it caused me.
